sources.title: [LINUX][Nura/postmarketOS] Mi A3 as a Linux mainline 7.2 home server ...
sources.snippet: This turns the Mi A3 into a small always-on Linux box on postmarketOS (mainline kernel 7.2, sm61x5-mainline). Mine runs Docker containers, Tailscale and ssh on the charger, and holds the battery at 50 % so it doesn't swell, plus some thermal guards just in case. On top of stock pmOS aka Nura it adds out-of-tree kernel modules, device-tree changes, a touch dashboard on the phone's screen and a ...
